sloka: स तं महामेघनिकाशरूपमुत्पाट्य गच्छन् युधि कुम्भकर्णः।रराज मेरुप्रतिमानरूपो मेरुर्यथा ऽभ्युच्छ्रितघोरशृङ्गः ।। ६.६७.७० ।।
transliteration: sa taṁ mahāmeghanikāśarūpamutpāṭya gacchan yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ।rarāja merupratimānarūpo meruryathā 'bhyucchritaghoraśṛṅgaḥ ।। 6.67.70 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna approaching the Vanara Lord Sugriva endowed with wonderful and dreadful prowess, went like wind carrying clouds taking him.
